required_steps.text: Check for a relevant healthy development server and reuse it instead of starting a duplicate process.
Use an available browser tool to navigate to the actual changed page.
Exercise every interaction and state transition affected by the change.
Verify relevant desktop and mobile viewports when layout or responsive behavior is affected.
Inspect the browser console for errors related to the changed behavior.
Inspect relevant requests and responses when the changed behavior is request-driven.
Capture screenshot, DOM, or accessibility evidence when it materially proves the result.

Fix only defects introduced by the current change or defects necessary to complete the user's explicit request, then repeat affected checks until they pass or a concrete blocker prevents completion; report pre-existing or adjacent defects unless separately authorized.

fallback_when_unavailable.text: Run the strongest available build, test, type, lint, or static checks when browser or service verification is unavailable.
Report the exact blocker and each browser-visible behavior that remains unverified.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not start a duplicate development server when a relevant healthy server already exists.
Do not claim browser-visible behavior passed when browser verification did not run.

Do not stop after merely reporting a defect introduced by the current change or necessary to complete the user's explicit request; fix and retest unless concretely blocked. Report pre-existing or adjacent defects without fixing them unless separately authorized.
